title: Man & woman, both 24, die in Tampines Ave 12 accident involving 2 cars & 1 motorcycle
text:
Man & woman, both 24, die in Tampines Ave 12 accident involving 2 cars & 1 motorcycle - Mothership.SG - News from Singapore, Asia and around the world 
 ">
News
 Man & woman, both 24, die in Tampines Ave 12 accident involving 2 cars & 1 motorcycle
 The police are looking for two people from one car who fled the scene.
 Belmont Lay 
 October 30, 2026, 11:08 AM
Photos via SGRoad Blocks / Traffic News
 A man and a woman died following an accident involving two cars and a motorcycle on Oct. 29 night at Tampines Avenue 12. 
 A male motorcyclist and his female pillion rider, both aged 24, died of their injuries after they were conveyed unconscious to the hospital, the police told Mothership in response to media queries. 
 Police looking for two others
 The authorities are searching for a male driver and a female passenger who fled the scene before police officers arrived. 
 "Preliminary investigations revealed that they had left the scene after the accident. Efforts to establish their whereabouts are underway," the police added. 
 The police said a 25-year-old female driver of one of the cars in the accident was taken conscious to the hospital. 
 The Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) said two people were taken to Changi General Hospital and two others were taken to Sengkang General Hospital. 
 Police investigations are ongoing. 
 Aftermath of accident
 Photos and videos of the aftermath of the accident showed three vehicles that were badly damaged. 
 Photo via SGRoad Blocks / Traffic News
 Photo via SGRoad Blocks / Traffic News
 Photo via SGRoad Blocks / Traffic News
 Photo via SGRV Front Man
 A black car on the grass patch had its rear bumper dislodged. 
 Another dark-coloured car was on its side in the bushes. 
 A tree and a pole appeared to have been knocked over. 
 A motorcycle was left mangled on the road. 
 The road was covered in debris and vegetation.
